notes: Source of truth for project types, project variables and cost items. docs/implementation/PROJECT_TYPE_CHECKLISTS.md is generated from this file (scripts/catalogue-report.ts).
src tags: V = verified 2026-10-21 against ref; S = authoritative source identified, values to ingest; Q = quote or consultant estimate (no public schedule); P = proposed, not law.
when: every condition must hold. 'var' = truthy; 'var=value' = enum match; 'var>=n' = numeric threshold.
Values marked V are as published on the asOf date. Re-verify before use in a locked scenario.

items.label: Market study, appraisal, broker opinion of value
Market data subscriptions (Altus Data Studio, Urbanation, CoStar)
Construction cost benchmark (Altus Canadian Cost Guide 2026, released 2026-04-23)
Toronto municipal land transfer tax (luxury brackets from 2026-04-01: 4.40%–8.60% above $3M)
HST on land (taxable supply; registrant self-assesses)
Land assembly premium and holdout costs
Land loan: interest, fees, lender legal, appraisal
Phase One ESA (Phase-One-only RSCs no longer filable unless required, since 2025-10-23)
Phase Two ESA: boreholes, sampling, lab
Record of Site Condition + MECP filing (O. Reg. 153/04)
Geotechnical investigation (per-borehole pricing; ~0.2–0.4% of construction for low-rise)
Designated substance survey (asbestos, lead, mould; O. Reg. 278/05)
Arborist report and tree protection plan
Natural heritage / environmental impact study, species at risk
Transportation impact study, TDM plan, parking study
Rail proximity: safety/vibration study, crash wall or berm design
Functional servicing and stormwater management report
Grading, stormwater, drainage and erosion-control review fees
items.note: TMU Group 4, Competitive Costs of Doing Business in Grimsby (Nov 2025)

items.label: Energy strategy, energy model, Toronto Green Standard checklist
Planning justification report, urban design brief, community consultation
TTC technical review (work within 60 m of TTC infrastructure)
TTC-required protections, monitoring and design changes
Airport zoning: legal survey showing the building clears the AZR surface
NAV CANADA land use proposal (building and cranes; 8–12 week review, valid up to 18 months)
Transport Canada Aeronautical Assessment Form (obstacle marking and lighting; ~90-day review)
Land-use compatibility study near major facilities (air quality, odour, risk; PPS 2024, D-6)
Structural/vibration review and protection for transit infrastructure below the site
Secondary plan and SASP policy review (height, density, use and community benefit requirements)
Greenbelt Plan conformity: planning justification, natural heritage evaluation and agency review
Conservation authority permit and review fees (TRCA / CLOCA)
Lifting the holding (H) symbol: application, fee and the conditions it is tied to (servicing, agreements)
Publicly-assisted university land: Planning Act approvals may not apply (Bill 185) — confirm scope with counsel
Ontario Land Tribunal appeal: legal and experts
Planner, architect and legal time through approvals
Pre-consultation and review fees (planning, engineering, urban design)
items.note: TMU Group 4, Competitive Costs of Doing Business in Grimsby (Nov 2025)

DC credits for works built by the developer (e.g. transit: 334–350 Bloor St W)
Building permit fee (Toronto Municipal Code Ch. 363)
